name: Dante
source:
Haughty and callous, Enten has the utmost confidence in his own power and abilities. Possessing the air of a true leader, he judges all by their strengths and weaknesses. Be it waging war or ruling over a city, he handles all duties with great aplomb. If only he could express his feelings a little better...

[Modified from the [url=https://nucarnival.com/en-US/News/Detail/Sun-Lord-of-Solaria-%E2%80%94-Dante]official website[/url]]
